text: The satellite sensors checked for fire detections on this rural property (ASSET-F03) were VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS. All these sensors provided continuous coverage from October 4, 2026, to November 3, 2026. No thermal anomalies were detected within the asset boundary during this period. The data sources included both VIIRS (375m resolution) and MODIS (1km resolution) thermal anomaly detections from NASA FIRMS.
